row.body: The shell box is signed out at 6:10, the marked route is closed at 5:40, and a spare key is still tied to the map. The return box is blank.
row.title: Inventory closed before the gate

sidecar.gloss: A collection record places a route closure before the return of its equipment.
sidecar.rival_reading: A test crew could have recorded a temporary site closure before retrieving equipment; the blank line does not say who set the schedule.
